scope: Native desktop file drops with reviewed import paging and GIS display choices
behavior: Drop one or multiple local files, up to 256 at once
Page or select files; retain mapping drafts while the queue is open
Append by default and use the existing all-row review and commit flow
Offer Import as Events or Add reference layer for dual-purpose GIS files, including from mapping
Immediately load display-only 3D Tiles/glTF/GLB assets; position standalone models at the current view center
Group Shapefile companions; report per-file failures without blocking later files
Completed pages cannot import Events or add reference layers twice
Single workspace drops use ordinary Open; mixed workspace drops cannot replace the dataset
Import commit returns its new workspace identity, allowing continuation only in the workspace produced by that commit

checks: Multiple drops deduplicate paths; paging preserves mapping drafts; closing before import changes no Events
Each reviewed CSV imports exactly once; the second appends without replacing the first; completed pages cannot duplicate Events

A malformed file does not block later pages; reference display is also available after opening Event mapping
Shapefile companions are collected with their layer rather than imported as separate files
Mixed workspace drops cannot replace the dataset; import modal remains usable at the minimum window size
